phases.name: Benchmark on public data

phases.detail: Dates and times passed 90%. Bigram decoder lifted 500-word sentences to 46.5%; phoneme targets are next.

phases.name: Tiny and fast in the browser
phases.goal: Under 10 MB, runs on the device, no server
phases.detail: 9 MB model decodes in the browser. Afono Nullpoint desktop app runs all three models locally.

phases.name: Afono DOM Model
phases.goal: Pick from what is on screen: links, buttons, fields
phases.detail: Chrome extension v0 numbers every target and runs commands; 17 of 17 on our fixture. WebUI benchmark next.

phases.goal: Webcam gaze that snaps to page targets
phases.detail: v0 built: 9-point calibration, accuracy test and 12-target test. First human results next.
